thread:
Rina (CS): quick capture from Arcadia Labs onboarding call earlier. They surfaced billing/reporting asks + an onboarding blocker. Renewal review in ~3 weeks, finance is nervous. Posting here for product triage.

Rina (CS): items from notes: 
- Request A: monthly CSV with per-route token usage + dollar amounts (need export for finance reconciliation).
- Request B: per-route budget caps (customer wants hard guardrails to prevent surprise overages during experiments).
- Request C: tagging/metadata on routes for billing (they want ability to attach customer-defined billing tags so finance can roll up costs).
- Request D: onboarding flow misses an explicit KMS/service-account verification step; their SREs get stuck and won't go live.

Leah (PM): thanks. Can you add suggested impact/urgency? Renewal in ~3w pushes higher.

Rina (CS): quick impact: A=high (finance won't sign renewal without exports). B=medium-high (risk of surprise overage and churn). C=medium (nice-to-have for their accounting). D=high (blocks go-live).

Olivier (Eng): feasibility notes: A (CSV export) = small-to-medium (usage backend + CSV endpoint + UI link). B (budget caps) = medium (requires enforcement at ingress + billing integration; need policy layer). C (billing tags) = small (route metadata + reporting pipeline). D (KMS verification step) = small (onboarding modal + backend verification + docs). Security signoff needed for D and B.

Leah (PM): proposed triage: P0 = A (CSV export) & D (KMS verification) since finance + go-live block renewal. P1 = B (budget caps) and P2 = C (billing tags) unless customers request earlier. Thoughts?

Sam (SE): temporary workarounds: for CSV exports, share this ad-hoc script that composes a CSV from usage API. Also can gate routes with simple alerts for now to mimic caps. Example snippet:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=arcadia&group_by=route&start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-31" \
  | jq -r '.routes[] | [.route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > arcadia-mar.csv
```
Sam (SE): for budget caps, suggest we create alerting thresholds + webhook to disable traffic as a stopgap.

Priya (Enablement): I can run a joint onboarding session tomorrow 2pm PT to walk Arcadia through the manual CSV, KMS steps, and temporary alert wiring. I'll prepare a one-pager checklist and a short recording. Can product add the checklist text to the onboarding modal as an interim copy?

Leah (PM): yes, add the modal copy short-term. I'll open two tickets: (1) spike for CSV export + reporting fields, (2) KMS verification UX + backend check + security review. Olivier, can you pick the KMS spike (1d) and post findings here?

Olivier (Eng): I'll take the KMS spike Monday. Will also note security touchpoints and estimate for budget caps once we have an infra sketch.

Rina (CS): customer update plan: immediate enablement session + manual CSV repo + alerts for caps; product is prioritizing CSV + KMS spike. Arcadia seemed relieved and will wait for the enablement session before finalizing renewal.

triage-bot: reminder: create ticket "onboarding: KMS verification + CSV reporting" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
